notes: Encoded ONLY from this brand's own page; nothing imported from the identically worded Duromatic-Olsen page. Serial is all digits, so the page's 'numerical digits' are character positions. Page example decodes to March 1985.

styles.notes: Page positions 1st & 2nd = year, 3rd & 4th = month (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges [0,2] and [2,4].
